resale_co.name: Construction Records Clearance (CRC)
requirements: Records search showing no open construction permits (building, electric, plumbing, mechanical or fire) or violations on the property
Application lists the property address, block and lot, owner, agent and closing date
resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the City's Construction Records Clearance Application (linked on the Construction page) and submit it with the $50.00 fee to the Construction Office, City Hall, Second Floor, 18 York Street, Lambertville, NJ 08530. Pay by check payable to the City of Lambertville or online (credit card or e-check). Office hours are weekdays 9:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. (Tuesday to 7:30 p.m., Friday to 12:30 p.m.).

resale_co.notes: Lambertville does not appear to do a resale housing inspection: a search of the City code on ecode360 found no resale or change-of-ownership certificate of occupancy for homes. The City's Construction page lists three things a seller needs before a sale: the smoke certification from the Lambertville Fire Department, a Construction Records Clearance (CRC) from the Construction Office to confirm there are no open permits, and a sump pump inspection from the Lambertville Municipal Utilities Authority. The CRC is a records check, not an inspection of the house. The CRC form is a Google document linked from the City page. Emails come from the Construction page (constructionofficial@lambertvillenj.org for Paul Hardifer, Jr.; construction@lambertvillenj.org for the office). The office's main line is 609-397-0110, press 2.

requirements: Smoke alarms per the year the home was built (for example, before January 1977 battery alarms on all levels; March 2016 to present hardwired, interconnected alarms with battery backup on every level, near and in each sleeping area); battery-only alarms must be 10-year sealed, UL 217 listed, and no older than 10 years
Basement battery smoke alarms within 10 feet of the base of the stairs
Low voltage/central alarm systems need a full NFPA 72 inspection report from a certified contractor
Carbon monoxide alarms (UL 2034) in the immediate vicinity of the sleeping areas, within 10 feet of sleeping room doors

Portable fire extinguisher, ABC type rated at least 2A-10B:C and no more than 10 pounds, within 10 feet of the kitchen in the path of egress, mounted on the manufacturer's bracket, serviced and tagged within 12 months or with a recent purchase receipt (form says still required per municipal ordinance 11-1.8) (form still lists it)
Secondary power source label (CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER) within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and meter, if the home has a generator, solar panels or battery storage
A representative must be on site; snow and ice must be cleared; power must be on

authorities.how_to_apply: Download the Application for Smoke Alarm, Carbon Monoxide Alarm & Fire Extinguisher Compliance from the Fire Marshal page, fill it out completely and send it with the fee (checks payable to Lambertville Fire District # 1), or pay online through the District's electronic payment link. Incomplete applications or improper payments are rejected and need new fees.

fire_cert.notes: The City's Construction page sends sellers to the Lambertville Fire Department for the smoke certification; the fire district's Fire Marshal page posts the application with the fee tiers. The form still requires a portable fire extinguisher, citing municipal ordinance 11-1.8, even though the state dropped it from the sale certificate in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19). The state directory lists the Fire Official as Frank J Ur, phone (609) 397-0110 (City Hall main line) and smoke detector compliance phone (609) 397-0803; the fire station number on the district website is 609-397-2084.

other_items.label: Sump pump inspection (Lambertville Municipal Utilities Authority)
other_items.detail: All properties need an LMUA sump pump inspection before a sale or transfer of ownership. Sump pumps, dehumidifiers and other groundwater or surface drains may not be connected to the sewer; any found must be removed and capped, then reinspected. Inspections are 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1 to 3 p.m.; book with the LMUA at 609-397-1496 (8 a.m. to 4 p.m., Monday to Friday) or by email to mparsons@lambertvillemua.com.
